target_results.scene_gate: Require visible live collision volumes; no pixels without data is not a no-op.
target_results.effect_witness: RenderWorld +0x10 calls DrawPrimitives; live volume instances emit collision-volume geometry.

target_results.scene_gate: Use the natural frame if baseline is false; otherwise capture an explicit false anchor-seed phase before the first positive. Keep the camera pose stable and require visible swept-sphere/triangle/contact geometry.
target_results.effect_witness: RenderWorld +0x11 calls DrawTriangleTest; fixed swept sphere, triangle and contacts are drawn.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SC02=true for P/N and restore SC02 baseline.
target_results.effect_witness: DrawTriangleTest tests byte +0x12 and draws the enlarged padding sphere using mfPadding +0x3c.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SC02=true; compare opposite x offsets.
target_results.effect_witness: DrawTriangleTest consumes float +0x30 (TriX) in triangle vertex construction.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SC02=true; compare opposite y offsets.
target_results.effect_witness: DrawTriangleTest consumes float +0x34 (TriY) in triangle vertex construction.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SC02=true; compare opposite z offsets.
target_results.effect_witness: DrawTriangleTest consumes float +0x38 (TriZ) in triangle vertex construction.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SC02=true; compare 0.5 and 1.5 scales.
target_results.effect_witness: DrawTriangleTest consumes float +0x40 (TriScale) in triangle vertex construction.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SC02 and SC03 true for P/N; restore both baselines.
target_results.effect_witness: DrawTriangleTest consumes mfPadding +0x3c only while Draw Padding +0x12 is true.

target_results.scene_gate: Require a used cache slot with a valid visible triangle batch; otherwise change scene, do not claim no-op.
target_results.effect_witness: RenderWorld +0x54 calls DrawCachedObjectTriangles; reader walks used slots and valid Triangle4 batches.

target_results.scene_gate: Require a used slot with a visible populated sphere record; otherwise change scene, do not claim no-op.
target_results.effect_witness: RenderWorld +0x55 calls DrawCachedObjectSpheres; reader emits populated per-slot sphere records.

target_results.scene_gate: Require upstream shadow-map and world rendering gates plus a visible shadow receiver.
target_results.effect_witness: mbRenderShadowMapView gates shadow frustum queries and shadow dispatch.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SH02=true; require upstream Render world and visible world caster/receiver.
target_results.effect_witness: World shadow flag is combined with Render world before world caster dispatch.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SH02=true; require upstream Render race cars and a visible car caster/receiver.
target_results.effect_witness: Car shadow flag is combined with Render race cars and near-only policy before car dispatch.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SH02=true; require upstream Render props and visible prop caster/receiver.
target_results.effect_witness: Prop shadow flag is combined with Render props and near-only policy before prop dispatch.

target_results.scene_gate: Force SH02=true; require visible near and distant caster/receiver witnesses.
target_results.effect_witness: CSM flag selects 3 versus 1 cascade dispatches; ARTIST branches at 0x827C9708..0x827C9738.

target_results.scene_gate: GameplayExternal camera behaviour must be allocated and active; capture the camera-world ROI while following the player.
target_results.effect_witness: The original follow-camera pivot box/line overlay is gated by the behavior byte at +0xB5E.

target_results.scene_gate: Require a named player-jump moment attempt under the same driving setup; raw writes alone prove only registration/readback.
target_results.effect_witness: The allow-jump byte is copied into the moment shared-info gate consumed by the X360 moment update.

target_results.scene_gate: Require a named stunt moment attempt under the same driving setup; raw writes alone prove only registration/readback.
target_results.effect_witness: The allow-stunt byte is copied into the moment shared-info gate consumed by the X360 moment update.

target_results.scene_gate: Require a named hard-stop moment attempt under the same driving setup; raw writes alone prove only registration/readback.
target_results.effect_witness: The allow-hard-stop byte is copied into the moment shared-info gate consumed by the X360 moment update.

target_results.scene_gate: Require at least one behavior-printer message in the phase; the V6 screenshots did not isolate this writer effect.
target_results.effect_witness: The behavior DebugPrinter emits queued text only while its enabled byte is true.

target_results.scene_gate: Require an active moment/crash debug message; pair this site with the moment trigger context, then restore TRUE.
target_results.effect_witness: The moment DebugPrinter B gates the text lines sent through the generic DebugPrinter enabled check.

target_results.scene_gate: The consumer is conditional on mbCycleNormalCamSelector; do not claim a visible effect unless the cycle state is witnessed.
target_results.effect_witness: When the normal camera selector is cycling, this byte enables the current debug camera name text.

target_results.scene_gate: Use a moving DRIVING scene with at least two position-journal entries and an available world map.
target_results.effect_witness: The original world-map debug overlay runs only with this flag and more than one vehicle-position journal record.

target_results.scene_gate: Require the crash state update window; if no crash state is active, raw value passes only and no visual-effect claim.
target_results.effect_witness: The crash debug byte gates the original debug-print and selected-moment-render branch while the crash state is updating.

target_results.scene_gate: Require a camera with state bit 0x10000 set and no custom near distance; otherwise this value is not the active near reader.
target_results.effect_witness: When the camera has no custom near distance and state flag 0x10000 is set, the original returns the small-near global and projection copy consumes it.

target_results.scene_gate: Use the standard external camera with no custom near value and small-near state bit clear; include a stable close object for the clipping ROI.
target_results.effect_witness: When no custom near distance or small-near flag applies, the original selects this global and stores the resulting near plane into the CGS camera before projection update.

target_results.scene_gate: Use the same stable distant world landmark and camera pose; V6 moving-road frames did not isolate this far-clip consumer.
target_results.effect_witness: The original projection-copy path loads the default far plane, stores it into the CGS camera, and rebuilds the perspective matrix.

target_results.scene_gate: Require non-zero speed and ordinary Boost input for a consumer witness; compare the same road/pose with the byte enabled and disabled.
target_results.effect_witness: The original boost camera FOV/shake paths read the +0xB5F enable byte before applying effects.

note: Typed field behavior only; live consumer conditions and pixels require independent review.
